_comment: Fictional company, customers and people. All text is plain ASCII on purpose (the server mis-decodes a lone non-ASCII character in short texts).

dana.name: Dana Ruiz
dana.description: Senior support agent at Pebbleline (fictional). Answered the September and October tickets.

leo.name: Leo Park
leo.description: Support agent at Pebbleline (fictional), started this week. Handles today's tickets.

known_issues.workaround: sign out of Pebbleline on the iPad and sign back in
known_issues.text: KI-204 (open, workaround v1, 2026-09-18): Notes written on the iPad app 3.8 while offline do not appear on the desktop after the iPad reconnects. Workaround: sign out of Pebbleline on the iPad and sign back in to force a full resync.

known_issues.workaround: exclude Pebbleline from battery optimization in Android settings
known_issues.text: KI-207 (open, workaround v1, 2026-09-11): On Android tablets with battery saver on, notes sync to the desktop hours late or only when the app is reopened. Workaround: exclude Pebbleline from battery optimization in Android settings.

known_issues.workaround: open Trash in the sidebar and restore the note (kept for 30 days)
known_issues.text: KI-211 (by design, 2026-08-27): A note deleted on one device disappears everywhere at the next sync. Workaround: open Trash in the sidebar and restore the note; deleted notes are kept for 30 days.
KI-198 (fixed in desktop 5.2, 2026-08-14): Desktop search does not find notes created in the last hour on desktop app 5.1. Workaround: Settings > Search > Rebuild index.

withdrawal.reason: signing out discards notes that have not synced yet
withdrawal.withdrawn: sign out of Pebbleline on the iPad and sign back in
withdrawal.workaround: Settings > Sync > Export pending notes, then Settings > Sync > Force full resync; do not sign out
withdrawal.recovery: notes lost after a sign-out can be recovered by engineering from the iPad's sync journal within 14 days: escalate with the iPad's device ID
withdrawal.text: KI-204 (open, workaround v2, 2026-10-15): Notes written on the iPad app 3.8 while offline do not appear on the desktop after the iPad reconnects. Workaround v1 (sign out of Pebbleline on the iPad and sign back in) is WITHDRAWN: signing out discards notes that have not synced yet. Workaround v2: Settings > Sync > Export pending notes, then Settings > Sync > Force full resync; do not sign out. Notes lost after a sign-out can be recovered by engineering from the iPad's sync journal within 14 days: escalate with the iPad's device ID.

customers.name: Harbor Physio
customers.description: Pebbleline customer (fictional): a physiotherapy clinic. Contact: Mei Tanaka, practice manager.
customers.devices: Harbor Physio writes session notes on two iPads (Pebbleline iPad app 3.8) and reads them on a Windows desktop.

ticket.title: T-5120 Harbor Physio - iPad notes missing on desktop
turns: Mei Tanaka (practice manager, Harbor Physio): Our physios write session notes on the iPads in the treatment rooms, where there is no wifi. The notes never show up on the front-desk desktop afterwards.
Dana Ruiz (support, Pebbleline): Thanks Mei. Which iPad app version are you on?
Mei Tanaka (practice manager, Harbor Physio): 3.8 on both iPads. The desktop is Windows.
Dana Ruiz (support, Pebbleline): That is our known issue KI-204. Please sign out of Pebbleline on the iPad and sign back in; that forces a full resync and the notes should appear on the desktop.
Mei Tanaka (practice manager, Harbor Physio): Done, they are on the desktop now. Thank you.

advice.advised: sign out of Pebbleline on the iPad and sign back in
advice.text: Ticket T-5120 (2026-09-24, Dana Ruiz): iPad notes not reaching the desktop. Matched KI-204; told Harbor Physio to sign out of Pebbleline on the iPad and sign back in.

today.text: The notes from yesterday's sessions on the iPad are still not on the desktop. Should I sign out of Pebbleline on the iPad again like last time?

customers.name: Oakline Dental
customers.description: Pebbleline customer (fictional): a dental practice. Contact: Ravi Menon, practice owner.
customers.devices: Oakline Dental writes chairside notes on Android tablets and reads them on a Windows desktop.

ticket.title: T-5170 Oakline Dental - tablet notes late on desktop
turns: Ravi Menon (practice owner, Oakline Dental): Chairside notes from our tablets take hours to show up on the reception desktop.
Dana Ruiz (support, Pebbleline): Are the tablets iPads?
Ravi Menon (practice owner, Oakline Dental): No, Android tablets, with battery saver on.
Dana Ruiz (support, Pebbleline): Then it is not KI-204, which is iPad only. It is known issue KI-207: exclude Pebbleline from battery optimization in Android settings.
Ravi Menon (practice owner, Oakline Dental): That fixed it, notes arrive straight away now.

advice.advised: exclude Pebbleline from battery optimization in Android settings
advice.text: Ticket T-5170 (2026-09-30, Dana Ruiz): Android tablet notes late on the desktop. Not KI-204 (iPad only); matched KI-207 and told Oakline Dental to exclude Pebbleline from battery optimization.
